$comment: Framings of museum artworks for products that are not the shape of the work (app/lib/museumCrops.ts). area = the printed block of the sheet as fractions of the master (original less trim), so a crop never shows bare museum paper. Per shape: the crop centre (cx, cy as fractions of the master) and an optional zoom >= 1; the box is computed as the largest box of the shape's aspect inside the area, tightened by zoom and moved as little as possible to stay inside. A work lists only the shapes its products use. Each work records who chose its framings (chosen) and the owner's approval of them (approval); a product cannot be released from an unapproved work. Pixels are only cut, never generated. Prints, framed prints and mugs keep the whole composition and never use these.

chosen.note: Owner chose AI-chosen crops with no generated pixels on 2026-10-13; each framing keeps the subject of the work.

approval.note: Owner approved the proposed crops in chat; also accepted the ppi exceptions for canvas (140-162 ppi), 16x20, 20x24 and framed 16x20, and framed-with-print for museum works.
